sourceNote: Ministry of Justice (법무부) press release, 2026-07-07: '연봉 1억 문턱은 낮추고 체류기간은 최대 3년으로…'. Full text in visa_rules.pdf at repo root; no public URL captured yet.
disclaimer: General guidance only, based on the Ministry of Justice's F-1-D (Digital Nomad / Workation) visa announcement. Rules and thresholds are revised periodically — always confirm current requirements with the Ministry of Justice or your nearest Korean embassy or consulate before applying.

additionalFacts.minApplicantAgeExemption: Accompanying minor children are exempt from the age-18 minimum
additionalFacts.workRestriction: No local paid employment or for-profit activity permitted
additionalFacts.eligibleApplicantSummary: Employed by an overseas company in a remote-work-capable role, with at least 1 year in the same job/industry; accompanying spouse and minor children may join
additionalFacts.nonCapitalDefinitionNote: "Non-capital area" for visa purposes includes areas officially designated as population-decrease (인구감소관심지역), even when they sit administratively inside a capital-tier province — see populationDeclineAreas.json (list not yet sourced).
